EQUIPMENT

Compare the platforms.

Inspection, reach, contact cleaning and sediment removal each call for a different configuration.

8 platforms

Portable inspection ROV

R-20 / R-20Li

A compact 16 kg observation ROV with a tethered power supply (R-20) or an internal lithium battery (R-20Li), for fast visual checks where vehicle size and handling matter.

View equipment
Inspection ROV

R-30

A tethered inspection ROV for visual assessment of submerged structures, with payload and sensor selection matched to the task.

View equipment
Inspection ROV

R-45

A tethered inspection platform with a higher brochure payload than the R-30, for projects needing additional sensing or tooling.

View equipment
Light work-class ROV

R-150

A 195 kg light work-class ROV rated to 500 m, with a 20 kg payload and modular interfaces for sensors and tools on offshore and hydraulic-structure tasks.

View equipment
Crawler inspection robot

A-400

A 400 kg tracked underwater robot that switches between swimming and crawling on submerged structures, for dam, intake and hydropower inspection to 300 m.

View equipment
Tunnel inspection ROV

AD-400

A specialist platform for long-distance inspection of flooded water tunnels, combining a tethered vehicle with project-specific sensing and tether management.

View equipment
Underwater cleaning robot

A-80

A floating and crawling underwater platform described by the manufacturer for contact cleaning, with cavitation water-jet and brush configurations subject to application review.

View equipment
Underwater dredging robot

AD-100

A remotely operated platform described in the manufacturer brochure for underwater sump dredging, with suction, conveyance and treatment selected together.

View equipment
